title: Slot order plan
description: DRAFT (ADR docs/adr-plan-first-backup-executor.md). One trading day and one slot's intended buys, written by the primary Claude slot runner BEFORE placement and re-derivable by the backup executor. A plan is INPUT only: it is never evidence that anything was bought (broker order history is the only such evidence), and every order in it is re-validated by code against universe, do-not-buy list, per-order cap, daily and weekly caps from a fresh full-day order pull, one-order-per-ticker, and a fresh quote below the prior close before any placement. Validation failure means an empty plan plus a structured error, never a partial buy.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change; a reader rejects every other value.

trading_day.description: America/New_York trading date the plan is valid for. A plan for any other date is rejected.

slot.description: dca_runner slot id (the keys of dca_runner.SLOTS). A plan is valid only for its own slot.

generated_at_et.description: Timezone-aware America/New_York timestamp. Informational for audit; staleness is decided by trading_day and slot plus per-order fresh-quote checks, not by age.

generator.description: Which engine produced the plan. Does not affect validation.

ladder_version.description: The `version` field of config/sizing_ladder.json the plan was sized with. A mismatch against the reader's current config rejects the plan.

universe_hash.description: sha256 over the sorted, newline-joined active tickers from config/tickers.json, followed by a final newline. A mismatch against the reader's current universe rejects the plan (tamper or drift).

orders.description: Intended buys in allocation-priority order (higher multiplier, then larger drop_pct, then ticker alphabetical), matching dca_runner.plan_orders. At most one order per symbol.

symbol.description: Must be in config/tickers.json active and never in excluded (QBUT). whole_share tickers are out of scope for this plan.

notional_usd.description: Dollar amount, cent precision. Equals selected base x multiplier. The schema ceiling mirrors config/budgets.json circuit_breakers.max_per_order_usd; the code check reads the live value, not this number.

drop_pct.description: Percent below the prior close at decision time. Always positive: a plan lists only buys. The smallest drop that buys is set by the ticker's sizing (0.1% on the global ladder, as low as 0.01% on a per-ticker calibration).

prior_low.description: Null when unknown; the base is then the $1 scale.

ref_id.description: Deterministic UUIDv5 of dca-runner-<slot_id>-<trading_day>-<TICKER> (scripts.validate_native_placement.native_ref_id): the only form the broker's place_equity_order tool accepts. Reuse is NOT assumed to give broker-side idempotency (ADR decision D6); reconciliation depends on a fresh order pull.
